Market today: The mood is cautious, leaning negative for growth. A hotter-than-expected jobs report is driving expectations for higher Fed rates, which typically hurts your tech and chip names, especially on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-56.31%) and SPAL (-32.6%) are major concerns due to their leveraged nature and deep losses. SMH (-12.04%) is also flagged to TRIM and is near its stop. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on interest rate expectations and how they impact the broader tech sector. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs for further decay.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and deeply underwater positions.
plays: SOXL: The scanner says SELL. Given the -56.31% loss and leverage, consider exiting or setting a very tight, non-negotiable stop.
SMH: Trim this position as the scanner suggests, especially with its price nearing your 540 stop.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market drivers are not favorable for new long tech positions.
